subject: Slack messages not posting to channel
customer_question: We connected CloudDesk to Slack but new tickets aren't showing up in #support-alerts.
agent_answer: Confirmed the OAuth token had an expired scope after a Slack workspace admin change. Reconnected the integration under Settings > Integrations > Slack and re-selected the channel; messages resumed within a minute.

subject: How do I map tickets to specific Slack channels
customer_question: Can different ticket categories go to different Slack channels?
agent_answer: Yes — under Settings > Integrations > Slack > Routing Rules you can map a ticket tag or category to a specific channel. Walked customer through creating two rules for Billing and Technical tags.

subject: Slack app shows disconnected after SSO rollout
customer_question: After enabling SSO for our workspace, the Slack integration shows 'disconnected' status.
agent_answer: SSO changes revoked the original OAuth grant since it was tied to a user account that is now provisioned via SCIM. Reconnected using a service account and confirmed persistence.

subject: Webhooks arriving 2+ hours late
customer_question: Our webhook receiver is getting events hours after they happen, not in real time.
agent_answer: Checked delivery attempts and found the endpoint was returning 504s intermittently, triggering the retry backoff schedule (up to 12h between later attempts). Recommended acknowledging the webhook immediately and processing asynchronously.

subject: Signature verification always fails
customer_question: Every webhook we receive fails HMAC signature verification even though we copied the secret correctly.
agent_answer: Root cause was verifying against a re-parsed/re-serialized JSON object instead of the raw request body bytes, which changes key ordering. Provided a code sample using the raw payload.

subject: Webhook got auto-disabled
customer_question: Our webhook endpoint stopped receiving anything and the dashboard shows it as disabled.
agent_answer: 20+ consecutive deliveries failed (expired TLS cert on customer endpoint) which auto-disables the webhook. Customer renewed the cert; re-enabled the webhook and replayed the last 15 missed events.

subject: My SAML login stopped working after adding a new domain
customer_question: We added a second domain to our workspace last week and now some of our users can't log in via SSO.
agent_answer: Investigated and found the *original* domain's IdP signing certificate had actually expired around the same time, which was the real cause — the new domain was still pending its own DNS verification and was never the trigger. Guided admin to re-upload the current IdP cert.

subject: SAML signature invalid error
customer_question: Getting 'saml_signature_invalid' for all users trying to log in this morning.
agent_answer: IdP certificate had expired overnight (1-year rotation). Walked admin through downloading the renewed cert from Okta and uploading it under Settings > Security > SSO.

subject: New domain not enforcing SSO
customer_question: We verified our new domain but users on it can still log in with a plain password.
agent_answer: Domain verification alone doesn't enforce SSO. Set the enforce_sso flag via PATCH /v1/sso/domains/{domain_id} for the new domain; confirmed password login was blocked afterward.

subject: SCIM duplicate external ID error
customer_question: Provisioning a new user via SCIM throws scim_duplicate_external_id.
agent_answer: Found two records in the IdP directory sharing the same externalId after a prior HR system migration. Customer de-duplicated in their directory and the sync succeeded.

subject: Clock skew SAML error
customer_question: Random SAML failures, error code mentions clock skew.
agent_answer: Confirmed IdP server NTP sync had drifted 7 minutes. Customer resynced NTP and failures stopped.

subject: Getting 429 errors under normal usage
customer_question: We're well under our documented rate limit but still getting 429 responses.
agent_answer: Rate limiter was keying on IP address instead of API key after a recent deploy, and the customer sits behind a shared corporate NAT. Escalated to platform team; limiter fix deployed and counters reset.

subject: How to rotate an API key without downtime
customer_question: Need to rotate our production API key without breaking our integration.
agent_answer: Explained that old keys stay valid for 24 hours after a new key is generated, so both can run in parallel during cutover. Customer rotated successfully.

subject: OAuth redirect_uri_mismatch
customer_question: Our OAuth integration suddenly fails with redirect_uri_mismatch.
agent_answer: Customer's app had switched to a new subdomain and the registered redirect URI still pointed to the old one, including a missing trailing slash. Corrected the registration.

subject: invalid_grant on OAuth token exchange
customer_question: Token exchange fails with invalid_grant intermittently.
agent_answer: Authorization codes expire after 60 seconds and can only be used once; customer's server had a queuing delay before exchanging the code. Recommended exchanging immediately upon redirect.

subject: How do I add more agent seats
customer_question: We hired 3 more support agents and need more seats on our plan.
agent_answer: Walked customer through Settings > Billing > Seats > Add Seats; seats are prorated for the remainder of the billing cycle.

subject: Downgrade from Growth to Standard
customer_question: We want to downgrade our plan at renewal.
agent_answer: Confirmed downgrade takes effect at the next billing cycle and explained the feature differences (lower rate limit, fewer automation rules). Scheduled the downgrade.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count
customer_question: Our latest invoice charges for 45 seats but we only have 40 active agents.
agent_answer: Found 5 deactivated-but-not-removed agent accounts still counted as seats. Removed them and issued a prorated credit.

subject: How to set up ticket auto-assignment
customer_question: Can tickets be automatically assigned to agents based on category?
agent_answer: Directed to Settings > Automations > Assignment Rules and helped configure round-robin assignment for the 'Billing' category.

subject: API returns resource_not_found for valid ticket
customer_question: GET /tickets/{id} returns resource_not_found for a ticket I can see in the UI.
agent_answer: Customer was using a sandbox API key (cd_test_) against a production ticket ID. Confirmed key type and had them switch to a live key.

subject: Bulk webhook payload seems truncated
customer_question: Our tickets.bulk_updated webhook payload looks cut off compared to what we expect.
agent_answer: Payloads over 512 KB are chunked with a page field per the webhook spec; customer wasn't handling pagination on bulk events. Provided reassembly logic.

subject: Users logged out unexpectedly after SCIM update
customer_question: Several users got signed out right after we ran a SCIM sync.
agent_answer: Confirmed this is expected: deactivating/reactivating a user via SCIM revokes active sessions within 5 minutes as a security measure. No action needed; reactivated users simply log in again.

subject: Firewall blocking CloudDesk webhooks
customer_question: Our security team's firewall is blocking incoming webhook calls.
agent_answer: Directed customer to /v1/meta/webhook-ips to allowlist CloudDesk's current sending IP ranges.

subject: Duplicate Slack notifications for one ticket
customer_question: We're getting the same Slack alert twice for a single new ticket.
agent_answer: Customer had configured two overlapping routing rules pointing to the same channel. Removed the duplicate rule.

subject: What happens to a revoked API key mid-request
customer_question: If we revoke a key while a request is in flight, does it complete?
agent_answer: Explained that revocation is immediate — in-flight requests using the revoked key return 401 Unauthorized rather than completing.

subject: Azure AD certificate auto-rotated, SSO broke
customer_question: SSO broke overnight and we didn't change anything on our end.
agent_answer: Azure AD had performed an automatic certificate rollover. Retrieved the current cert from the Azure admin console and uploaded it to CloudDesk.

subject: How to replay a single missed webhook event
customer_question: One event never arrived — can we get just that one resent without replaying everything?
agent_answer: Used POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/events/{event_id}/replay to resend the single event; confirmed receipt with the customer.

subject: Difference between Standard and Growth rate limits
customer_question: What API rate limit do we get if we upgrade to Growth?
agent_answer: Explained Standard is 60 req/min per key, Growth is 300 req/min per key, and Enterprise is 1,200 req/min per key.

subject: Where to find API request_id for a failed call
customer_question: Support asked for a request_id but I don't see it in my error.
agent_answer: Showed customer the error envelope structure — request_id is included in every error response body for correlating with server logs.

subject: Webhook TLS handshake failing
customer_question: Deliveries to our endpoint fail with a TLS error.
agent_answer: Customer's certificate had expired 2 days prior. CloudDesk will not deliver to endpoints with invalid TLS by design. Customer renewed the cert and deliveries resumed automatically.

subject: Can we require SSO for only one domain
customer_question: We have two domains in our workspace but only want to force SSO for one.
agent_answer: Confirmed enforce_sso is set per verified domain, so this is supported out of the box — set the flag only on the target domain.

subject: Sandbox data leaking into production reports
customer_question: Test data seems to be showing up in our production dashboards.
agent_answer: Customer was using a cd_test_ sandbox key for some production integrations. Sandbox data is isolated by design; migrated the integration to a live key and confirmed dashboards cleared.

subject: Rate of failed webhook deliveries spiking platform-wide
customer_question: Multiple of our webhooks across different environments are failing around the same time.
agent_answer: This coincided with a platform-side sender degradation traced to the metadata lookup service; failed over to the standby region. Dead-letter queue drained automatically once resolved.

subject: Need itemized invoice for finance team
customer_question: Finance needs a breakdown of seats vs. add-ons on our invoice.
agent_answer: Generated an itemized invoice export from Settings > Billing > Invoices > Export and walked through each line item.

subject: How long are resolved tickets retained
customer_question: Is there a retention limit on resolved ticket data?
agent_answer: Confirmed resolved tickets are retained indefinitely unless a workspace-level data retention policy is configured under Settings > Data Retention.

subject: Getting logged out every hour via SSO
customer_question: Users on SSO are being logged out roughly every 60 minutes.
agent_answer: This matched expected OAuth access token expiry (1 hour) combined with the customer's IdP not silently refreshing sessions. Recommended enabling silent re-authentication in their IdP config.

subject: Do webhooks fire for bulk API updates
customer_question: If we update 100 tickets via the API at once, do we get 100 webhook events?
agent_answer: Confirmed bulk updates emit a single tickets.bulk_updated event (chunked if over 512 KB) rather than one event per ticket.

subject: Need higher rate limit temporarily for migration
customer_question: We're migrating 50k historical tickets and will exceed our rate limit.
agent_answer: Applied a temporary per-workspace throttle exception for the migration window via the infra admin tool, coordinated with the customer's migration schedule.

subject: Can Slack integration post customer replies too, not just new tickets
customer_question: We only see new-ticket alerts in Slack, not customer replies.
agent_answer: Added the 'ticket.customer_replied' event to their Slack routing rule so replies now post to the same channel.

subject: IdP metadata URL returns 404
customer_question: The SAML metadata URL you gave us returns a 404.
agent_answer: Customer had used the wrong workspace_id in the metadata URL after a workspace rename. Provided the correct current URL.

subject: How many retry attempts before a webhook is marked failed
customer_question: How many times will you retry before giving up on a webhook?
agent_answer: Explained the 6-attempt exponential backoff schedule (1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 12h) and that 20+ consecutive failures auto-disables the webhook.

subject: request_id missing from error, can't find in logs
customer_question: Getting a generic 500 error with no request_id — hard to debug.
agent_answer: Identified this as an edge case in an older SDK version that stripped the error envelope. Recommended upgrading to SDK v2.3+ where request_id is preserved.

subject: Can we pay annually instead of monthly
customer_question: Is there an annual billing option with a discount?
agent_answer: Confirmed annual billing is available with a 15% discount versus monthly; switched customer's plan to annual effective next cycle.
